newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end slightly higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end slightly higher in thin trade.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE
NIKKEI 19161.71 +77.46 LME CASH NICKEL US$6435 +0.0
CANDLR 1.3674 LME CASH ALUM US$1524.0 +1.0
CAN 30-YR 112.25 +0.40 FEB BRENT CRUDE US$23.45 +0.30
* Toronto stocks edged up 34.79 points in thin dealings with many players absent after the Christmas and Boxing Day holidays.

Toronto stocks ended slightly higher on Friday with very few stocks seeing activity, despite losing a day of trade to U.S. counterparts which rose on Thursday while Canadian markets were shut for Boxing Day.
"Not too much has happened," one trader said. "It was very, very quiet. Bonds and interest sensitive stocks were up some."
The TSE 300 Composite Index added 34.79 points to 5902.61 in trade of 32.2 million shares worth C$357.2 million. Advancing stocks led declines 464 to 344 with 272 stocks unchanged.
An unexpectedly weak U.S. durable goods number helped bonds and stocks rise in Toronto.
November durable goods orders fell 1.6 percent because of weaker demand for computer components and communications equipment, the U.S. Commerce Department said on Friday.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 14.23 to end the day at 6560.91.
--- HOT STOCKS ---
* Precision Drilling Corp was the net gain leader on the Toronto Exchange continuing a recent rally, rising 3.50 to 48.50 on volume of 86,400 shares dealings.
* TVX Gold was high on the active roster with a rise of 0.30 to 10.55 in turnover of 487,735 shares.
* Repap Enterprises also rose 0.02 to 3.92 on volume of 757,930 shares.
* Actives were led by United Rayore Gas, which rose 0.01 to 1.07 on 1,724,300.
